title: Sentinel Managed Security Service Description: Detection and Monitoring Coverage
content:
Each Sentinel Managed Security tier includes a defined set of detection and monitoring services. The table below states, tier by tier, which services are included and the figures attached to them.

## Service definitions

| Service | What the entry states |
|---|---|
| Around-the-clock SOC triage | Whether alerts are triaged by the security operations center 24 hours a day, seven days a week (included or not) |
| Threat hunting | Whether proactive analyst-led threat hunting is included |
| Identity threat detection | Whether Microsoft 365 and Entra ID identity threat detection is included |
| Email security | Whether inbound email security and phishing remediation is included |
| Mobile device coverage | Whether managed mobile devices are covered at no endpoint charge |
| Log retention | Days security telemetry is retained and searchable (whole days) |
| Vulnerability scanning | Internal vulnerability scanning cadence: none, quarterly, monthly, weekly or continuous |
| Dark web monitoring | Whether credential exposure monitoring for the client's domains is included |

## Coverage by tier

| Sentinel tier | SOC triage | Threat hunting | Identity threat detection | Email security | Mobile devices | Log retention (days) | Vulnerability scanning | Dark web monitoring |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | No | No | No | No | No | 30 | None | No |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | Yes | No | No | No | No | 90 | None | Yes |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | 90 | Quarterly | Yes |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | 365 | Monthly | Yes |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 365 | Weekly | Yes |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 730 | Continuous | Yes |

## Points read from the table

- Sentinel EDR Essentials is the only tier without SOC triage; it is also the only tier without dark web monitoring.
- Email security appears first on Sentinel XDR Premier, and mobile device coverage first on Sentinel MDR Complete.
- Threat hunting and identity threat detection are included from Sentinel MDR Advanced upward.
- Log retention runs from 30 days on Sentinel EDR Essentials to 730 days on Sentinel XDR Enterprise; Sentinel MDR Standard and Sentinel MDR Advanced share 90 days, and Sentinel MDR Complete and Sentinel XDR Premier share 365 days.
- Vulnerability scanning becomes more frequent with each tier from Sentinel MDR Advanced (quarterly) to Sentinel XDR Enterprise (continuous); the two lowest tiers include none.
